Job Description: Join our partner in Saudi Arabia, a visionary leader crafting innovative technology and AI solutions! We’re recruiting exceptional talent for their on‑site tech team to power transformative projects that redefine the future. If you’re driven by tech and AI, seize this opportunity to thrive in a vibrant, collaborative setting. This is a full‑time onsite opportunity in Saudi Arabia.
Responsibilities
• Conduct user interviews, surveys, and usability testing to understand user needs and preferences.
• Analyze and interpret research data to inform design decisions.
• Design the structure and organization of the AI solution, including navigation and information flow.
• Create wireframes and prototypes to illustrate the user interface.
• Define and design interactive elements and transitions.
• Ensure a seamless and intuitive user experience through thoughtful interaction design.
• Plan and conduct usability testing sessions to gather feedback on design prototypes.
• Iteratively refine designs based on user testing results.
• Work closely with cross‑functional teams, including developers, product owners, and stakeholders.
• Collaborate on the implementation of designs and provide support during development.
• Create visually appealing and consistent user interfaces based on UX specifications.
• Develop style guides and design systems to maintain a cohesive look and feel.
• Design icons, graphics, and other visual elements to enhance the aesthetic appeal of the AI solution.
• Ensure that the visual design aligns with the overall brand and user expectations.
• Design UI elements that are adaptable to various screen sizes and devices.
• Collaborate with developers to implement responsive designs.
• Develop high‑fidelity prototypes to communicate the visual aspects of the user interface.
• Iterate on designs based on feedback and usability testing results.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX/UI design, graphic design, HCI, or a related field.
• Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design.
• Skills: Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD. Solid understanding of user research, information architecture, and interaction design principles.

Add your Portfolio: Showcase a portfolio of previous design projects, highlighting the design process, problem‑solving skills, and the impact of your designs on user experience.

jobs.job_title: AI Solutions UI/UX Designer - Onsite in Saudi Arabia
jobs.job_description:
Skatch in Saudi Arabia is seeking an experienced UX/UI designer for on-site work, focusing on AI-driven solutions. You will conduct user research, design information architecture, and create intuitive interfaces that scale across devices.
Join a collaborative team to build wireframes and high-fidelity prototypes, contribute to design systems, and craft visuals that align with brand goals. Portfolio required for consideration.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

UX/UI Designer Lead

Full-time job. Start date: Immediately. Location: KSA for Saudi National Only.
The Role

The UX/UI Designer Lead will be engaged in all phases of the design development lifecycle, customer and end user engagement, creating application system models and participating in design meetings both internally and with customers. The UX/UI Designer Lead combines research and design skills to develop physical and online/mobile interactions of customers. The UX/UI Designer Lead creates clean, elegant, and user-centered designs based on business needs and customer feedback.
Accountabilities
• Deliver customer-centric products UX/UI iteratively and incrementally from a solution design perspective
• Work on improving creative processes and help develop innovative ideas and concepts
• Determine the layout of the navigation and how customers should interact with it
• Determine scope and time of work for creative design
• Develop site-maps, cohesive user interface architectures, wireframes, workflow diagrams, interactive mockups and prototypes
• Collect usability requirements (e.g. from usability sessions with business and other stakeholders) and incorporate feedback into user experience enhancements and/or new features, including navigation/usability
• Research interaction design & latest technology trends and share with team
• Lead and run usability testing
• Interact with solution architects and programmers to develop a prototype of new features and products
• Comply with sprint backlog in terms of activities prioritization
• Attend the daily stand-up meeting
Who should apply?
• Portfolio of design projects accessible online
• 5+ years of relevant experience
• Experience designing both e-commerce and B2B solutions
• Experience in SaaS environments
• Experience in the Insurance / Financial Services sector is a plus
• Knowledge of tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Zeplin, InVision, Balsamiq, Sketch, Flinto...
• Demonstrated ability to innovate and design exceptional user experiences
• Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and lead work from concept to completion
• Excellent organizational skills when it comes to defining, delivering, and documenting items in projects
• Proven ability to work across geographic and cultural boundaries, to work with complex customers, involving multiple stakeholders and potential partners involved in the ecosystem
• You thrive on working across a number of different clients and projects in an agile manner
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Fluent in English
What we offer
• A dynamic and exciting start-up environment
• The opportunity to work for a meaningful cause
• The potential to grow in one of the most promising social startups in the region
• A degree of freedom and flexibility to shape the role and experience all sides of a growing business
• Flexible working hours and locations
#J-18808-Ljbffr

• Fluent in English and native in Arabic.
• Based in Egypt or Saudi Arabia.
• Available to commit full-time for the six-month internship, with reasonable flexibility for university examinations and mandatory lectures through prior coordination.
• Have a dependable personal laptop for remote work.

jobs.job_description:
About the role

The company Studio is a Saudi AI application designed to transform plain-language business descriptions into functional business systems, such as HR platforms, online stores, and sales boards. Our team in Riyadh is dedicated to enhancing business operations across the Kingdom and beyond.

What you will do

• Design screens and workflows for the company Studio application across iPhone, Android, and web platforms.

• Create templates for business systems developed within the company Studio, accommodating both Arabic (right to left) and English languages.

• Conduct user testing on designs and implement improvements based on feedback.

• Maintain the design system, ensuring colors, typography, and components are in sync with development needs.

• Review designs prior to each release to ensure quality and functionality.

What we need

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience is required.

• Must be based in Riyadh or willing to relocate.

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in designing mobile and web applications; a portfolio showcasing past work is required.

• Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with designing right-to-left Arabic interfaces.

• Fluency in both Arabic and English, written and spoken.

Pay and terms

• Monthly salary ranges from SAR 14,000 to 20,000 (inclusive of basic salary and allowances), commensurate with experience.

• Full-time position, on-site in our Riyadh office; working hours and annual leave follow Saudi Labour Law regulations.

• Health insurance and GOSI registration provided, in accordance with Saudi law.

How we select

• Applications will receive responses within 7 days.

• Initial 30-minute video call to introduce you to the company Studio.

• For shortlisted candidates, a design exercise lasting 30 minutes will be conducted using the company Studio on our test account (no personal accounts needed).

• Final interview in Riyadh with all candidates informed of their interview results within 30 days.

Applications

Applications are accepted online only through this job posting until 14 January 2027. Each application is evaluated based on skills and experience, and adjustments for candidates with disabilities are available upon request.
